organizations.name: Trinity Episcopal Cathedral
organizations.description: Historic Episcopal cathedral overlooking the Truckee River in downtown Reno, operating a Sack Lunch Ministry that distributes free bag lunches, coffee, and pet food three days a week. Also runs a Clothes Closet providing free clothing on the 2nd Saturday of each month, a Baby Bundles program for disadvantaged new parents, and food collection for St. Paul's Food Pantry in Sparks.

es.description: Catedral episcopal historica con vista al rio Truckee en el centro de Reno, que opera un Ministerio de Almuerzos en Bolsa que distribuye almuerzos en bolsa gratuitos, cafe y alimento para mascotas tres dias a la semana. Tambien administra un Armario de Ropa que proporciona ropa gratuita el segundo sabado de cada mes, un programa Baby Bundles para nuevos padres desfavorecidos y recoleccion de alimentos para la Despensa de Alimentos de St. Paul's en Sparks.
es.eligibility: No se requiere identificación, todos bienvenidos

tl.description: Makasaysayang Episcopal cathedral na nakatanaw sa Truckee River sa downtown Reno, na nagpapatakbo ng Sack Lunch Ministry na namamahagi ng libreng bag lunches, kape, at pagkain ng alagang hayop tatlong beses sa isang linggo. Nagpapatakbo rin ng Clothes Closet na nagbibigay ng libreng damit sa ika-2 Sabado ng bawat buwan, isang Baby Bundles program para sa mga disadvantaged na bagong magulang, at food collection para sa St. Paul's Food Pantry sa Sparks.
tl.eligibility: Hindi kailangan ng ID, lahat ay welcome

zh.description: 俯瞰里诺市中心特拉基河的历史性圣公会大教堂，运营袋装午餐事工，每周三天分发免费袋装午餐、咖啡和宠物食品。还运营衣物衣柜（每月第二个星期六提供免费衣物）、为弱势新生儿父母提供的Baby Bundles项目和为斯帕克斯St. Paul's食品储藏室收集食物。
zh.eligibility: 无需身份证件，欢迎所有人

vi.description: Nha tho lon Episcopal lich su nhin ra song Truckee o trung tam Reno, dieu hanh Muc vu Bua trua Tui phan phoi bua trua mien phi, ca phe va thuc an cho thu cung ba ngay moi tuan. Cung dieu hanh Tu do Quan ao cung cap quan ao mien phi vao thu Bay thu 2 moi thang, chuong trinh Baby Bundles cho cha me moi thieu thon va thu gom thuc pham cho Kho thuc pham St. Paul's tai Sparks.
vi.eligibility: Không cần giấy tờ tùy thân, chào đón tất cả

organizations.name: St. Vincent's Dining Room
organizations.description: Reno's longest-running free meal program, established in 1961, operated by Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada. Serves approximately 1,400 free hot take-out style meals daily to anyone who is hungry -- no questions asked, no ID required. Open 7 days a week including holidays, having served more than 3 million meals since its founding.

es.description: El programa de comidas gratuitas mas antiguo de Reno, establecido en 1961, operado por Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada. Sirve aproximadamente 1,400 comidas calientes gratuitas estilo para llevar diariamente a cualquier persona que tenga hambre -- sin preguntas, sin identificacion requerida. Abierto los 7 dias de la semana incluyendo dias festivos, habiendo servido mas de 3 millones de comidas desde su fundacion.

tl.description: Ang pinakamatagal na libreng meal program ng Reno, itinatag noong 1961, pinapatakbo ng Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada. Nagsisilbi ng humigit-kumulang 1,400 libreng mainit na take-out style meals araw-araw sa sinumang nagugutom -- walang tanungan, walang ID na kailangan. Bukas 7 araw sa isang linggo kasama ang mga holiday, nakapagsilbi na ng mahigit 3 milyong pagkain mula nang itatag.

zh.description: 里诺历史最悠久的免费餐食项目，成立于1961年，由北内华达州天主教慈善机构运营。每天为任何饥饿的人提供约1,400份免费热外带餐——不问任何问题，不需要身份证件。每周7天开放，包括节假日，自成立以来已提供300多万份餐食。

vi.description: Chuong trinh bua an mien phi lau doi nhat cua Reno, thanh lap nam 1961, do Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada dieu hanh. Phuc vu khoang 1.400 bua an nong mien phi kieu mang di moi ngay cho bat ky ai doi -- khong hoi gi, khong can giay to. Mo 7 ngay mot tuan ke ca ngay le, da phuc vu hon 3 trieu bua an tu khi thanh lap.
vi.eligibility: Chào đón tất cả mọi người

organizations.name: Family Soup at Believe Plaza
organizations.description: All-volunteer grassroots mutual aid group serving free hot home-cooked meals, hygiene supplies, warm clothing, harm reduction supplies (Narcan, fentanyl test strips), and other necessities every Tuesday at Believe Plaza in downtown Reno. Serves 100+ people weekly and has operated continuously for over four years. Entirely funded by community donations.

es.description: Grupo de ayuda mutua comunitario compuesto enteramente por voluntarios que sirve comidas calientes caseras gratuitas, suministros de higiene, ropa abrigada, suministros de reduccion de danos (Narcan, tiras de prueba de fentanilo) y otras necesidades todos los martes en Believe Plaza en el centro de Reno. Sirve a mas de 100 personas semanalmente y ha operado continuamente durante mas de cuatro anos. Financiado enteramente por donaciones comunitarias.

tl.description: All-volunteer grassroots mutual aid group na nagsisilbi ng libreng mainit na lutong-bahay na pagkain, hygiene supplies, mainit na damit, harm reduction supplies (Narcan, fentanyl test strips), at iba pang pangangailangan tuwing Martes sa Believe Plaza sa downtown Reno. Nagsisilbi sa 100+ na tao bawat linggo at patuloy na gumagana sa loob ng apat na taon. Ganap na pinopondohan ng mga donasyon mula sa komunidad.

zh.description: 全志愿者基层互助团体，每周二在里诺市中心Believe Plaza提供免费热家常餐、卫生用品、保暖衣物、减害用品（纳洛酮、芬太尼测试条）和其他必需品。每周服务100多人，已持续运营四年以上。完全由社区捐款资助。

vi.description: Nhom tuong tro co so tu nguyen phuc vu bua an nong nau tai nha mien phi, vat dung ve sinh, quan ao am, vat tu giam hai (Narcan, que thu fentanyl) va cac nhu yeu pham khac moi thu Ba tai Believe Plaza o trung tam Reno. Phuc vu hon 100 nguoi moi tuan va da hoat dong lien tuc hon bon nam. Hoan toan duoc tai tro boi cac khoan quyen gop cong dong.
vi.eligibility: Chào đón tất cả mọi người

organizations.name: Mutual Aid Mondays at Our Center
organizations.description: Weekly mutual aid gathering every Monday evening at Our Center, Reno's LGBTQ+ community center. A collaborative space to strengthen community through sharing knowledge, resources, and wisdom. Open to all ages and identities -- attendees share what they can and take what they need.

es.description: Reunion semanal de ayuda mutua todos los lunes por la noche en Our Center, el centro comunitario LGBTQ+ de Reno. Un espacio colaborativo para fortalecer la comunidad compartiendo conocimientos, recursos y sabiduria. Abierto a todas las edades e identidades -- los asistentes comparten lo que pueden y toman lo que necesitan.

tl.description: Lingguhang mutual aid gathering tuwing Lunes ng gabi sa Our Center, ang LGBTQ+ community center ng Reno. Isang collaborative space para palakasin ang komunidad sa pamamagitan ng pagbabahagi ng kaalaman, resources, at karunungan. Bukas sa lahat ng edad at identidad -- ang mga dumadalo ay nagbabahagi ng kaya nila at kumukuha ng kailangan nila.

zh.description: 每周一晚上在Our Center（里诺LGBTQ+社区中心）举行的互助聚会。通过分享知识、资源和智慧来加强社区的协作空间。欢迎所有年龄和身份的人——参与者分享所能、各取所需。

vi.description: Buoi hop tuong tro hang tuan vao moi toi thu Hai tai Our Center, trung tam cong dong LGBTQ+ cua Reno. Khong gian hop tac de cung co cong dong thong qua chia se kien thuc, nguon luc va tri tue. Mo cho tat ca moi lua tuoi va ban sac -- nguoi tham du chia se nhung gi co the va nhan nhung gi can.
vi.eligibility: Chào đón tất cả mọi người

organizations.name: Food Bank of Northern Nevada
organizations.description: Largest hunger-relief organization in the region, distributing food through a network of 155+ partner agencies across 90,000 square miles spanning 13 Nevada counties and 10 eastern California counties. Serves over 155,000 people monthly through mobile pantries, neighborhood pantries, and emergency food assistance. Food distributions are NOT held at the warehouse -- use their online Food Finder tool to locate nearby distribution sites.

es.description: La organizacion de alivio del hambre mas grande de la region, distribuyendo alimentos a traves de una red de mas de 155 agencias asociadas en 90,000 millas cuadradas que abarcan 13 condados de Nevada y 10 del este de California. Sirve a mas de 155,000 personas mensualmente a traves de despensas moviles, despensas de vecindario y asistencia alimentaria de emergencia. Las distribuciones NO se realizan en el almacen -- use su herramienta Food Finder en linea para localizar sitios de distribucion cercanos.
es.serviceArea: Norte de Nevada y Sierra Oriental

tl.description: Pinakamalaking hunger-relief organization sa rehiyon, namamahagi ng pagkain sa pamamagitan ng network ng 155+ na kasosyong ahensya sa 90,000 square miles na sumasaklaw sa 13 county ng Nevada at 10 county ng silangang California. Nagsisilbi sa mahigit 155,000 tao buwan-buwan sa pamamagitan ng mobile pantries, neighborhood pantries, at emergency food assistance. Ang mga distribusyon ay HINDI ginaganap sa warehouse -- gamitin ang kanilang online Food Finder tool para mahanap ang mga malapit na distribution site.

zh.description: 该地区最大的饥饿救济组织，通过155多个合作机构网络在覆盖13个内华达州县和10个加利福尼亚东部县的90,000平方英里范围内分发食品。每月通过流动食品站、社区食品站和紧急食品援助服务155,000多人。食品分发不在仓库进行——请使用其在线Food Finder工具查找附近的分发点。
zh.serviceArea: 内华达州北部和东部山脉

vi.description: To chuc cuu tro doi lon nhat trong khu vuc, phan phoi thuc pham thong qua mang luoi hon 155 co quan doi tac tren 90.000 dam vuong bao gom 13 quan Nevada va 10 quan dong California. Phuc vu hon 155.000 nguoi moi thang thong qua cac kho thuc pham luu dong, kho thuc pham khu pho va ho tro thuc pham khan cap. Viec phan phoi KHONG dien ra tai kho — hay su dung cong cu Food Finder truc tuyen de tim cac diem phan phoi gan ban.

organizations.name: Hampton House Garden
organizations.description: Black-led community project advancing Black and Indigenous food justice in Reno. Operates a 24/7 open-access food pantry and refrigerator with no requirements to receive food, plus a community garden, food recovery compost facility, harm reduction supply hub, and organizing creative space. Also runs a free weekday Breakfast & Homework Club (7:30-8:30 AM) and partners with Good Neighbors Warming Center for emergency winter shelter.

es.description: Proyecto comunitario liderado por personas negras que promueve la justicia alimentaria para personas negras e indigenas en Reno. Opera una despensa de alimentos y refrigerador de acceso abierto las 24 horas sin requisitos, ademas de un jardin comunitario, instalacion de compostaje, centro de suministros de reduccion de danos y espacio creativo de organizacion. Tambien ofrece un programa gratuito de Desayuno y Tareas (7:30-8:30 AM entre semana) y es socio del Good Neighbors Warming Center para refugio de emergencia en invierno.

tl.description: Black-led na proyektong pangkomunidad na nagsusulong ng Black at Indigenous food justice sa Reno. Nagpapatakbo ng 24/7 open-access food pantry at refrigerator nang walang kinakailangan, kasama ang community garden, food recovery compost facility, harm reduction supply hub, at organizing creative space. Nagpapatakbo rin ng libreng Breakfast & Homework Club (7:30-8:30 AM sa weekdays) at kasosyo ng Good Neighbors Warming Center para sa emergency winter shelter.

zh.description: 由黑人领导的社区项目，推动里诺黑人和原住民食品正义。运营24/7开放的免费食品储藏室和冰箱（无需任何条件），以及社区花园、食物回收堆肥设施、减害用品中心和组织创意空间。还运营免费的工作日早餐和作业俱乐部（早上7:30-8:30）并与Good Neighbors温暖中心合作提供冬季紧急庇护。
zh.eligibility: 欢迎所有人，无需任何条件

vi.description: Du an cong dong do nguoi Da den lanh dao, thuc day cong bang thuc pham cho nguoi Da den va Ban dia tai Reno. Van hanh kho thuc pham va tu lanh mo 24/7 khong can dieu kien, cung voi vuon cong dong, co so u phan thuc pham, trung tam vat tu giam hai va khong gian sang tao to chuc. Cung dieu hanh Cau lac bo An sang & Bai tap mien phi (7:30-8:30 sang cac ngay trong tuan) va hop tac voi Good Neighbors Warming Center cho noi tru mua dong khan cap.
vi.eligibility: Chào đón tất cả, không yêu cầu gì

organizations.name: Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada
organizations.description: The largest social services provider in Northern Nevada, serving over 100,000 individuals annually across all 12 counties of the Diocese of Reno. Operates St. Vincent's Dining Room (1,400 free meals daily), Nevada's largest food pantry at 435 Eureka Ave (15,000+ people monthly), immigration legal services, Battle Born Housing Plus recovery residences, rental/utility assistance, senior home delivery meals, workforce development, and family mentoring programs.

es.description: El proveedor de servicios sociales mas grande del norte de Nevada, sirviendo a mas de 100,000 personas anualmente en los 12 condados de la Diocesis de Reno. Opera el comedor St. Vincent's (1,400 comidas gratuitas diarias), la despensa de alimentos mas grande de Nevada en 435 Eureka Ave (mas de 15,000 personas mensuales), servicios legales de inmigracion, residencias de recuperacion Battle Born Housing Plus, asistencia de alquiler/servicios publicos, entrega de comidas a domicilio para personas mayores, desarrollo laboral y programas de mentoria familiar.

tl.description: Ang pinakamalaking tagapagbigay ng social services sa Northern Nevada, nagsisilbi sa mahigit 100,000 na indibidwal taon-taon sa lahat ng 12 county ng Diocese of Reno. Pinapatakbo ang St. Vincent's Dining Room (1,400 libreng pagkain araw-araw), ang pinakamalaking food pantry ng Nevada sa 435 Eureka Ave (15,000+ tao buwan-buwan), immigration legal services, Battle Born Housing Plus recovery residences, tulong sa upa/utilities, paghahatid ng pagkain sa mga matatanda, workforce development, at family mentoring programs.

zh.description: 北内华达州最大的社会服务提供机构，每年服务里诺教区12个县的10万多人。运营圣文森特餐厅（每天提供1,400份免费餐食）、内华达州最大的食品储藏室（位于435 Eureka Ave，每月服务15,000多人）、移民法律服务、Battle Born Housing Plus康复住所、租金/水电援助、老年人送餐上门、劳动力发展和家庭辅导项目。

vi.description: Nha cung cap dich vu xa hoi lon nhat Bac Nevada, phuc vu hon 100.000 ca nhan hang nam tren 12 quan cua Giao phan Reno. Van hanh phong an St. Vincent's (1.400 bua an mien phi moi ngay), kho thuc pham lon nhat Nevada tai 435 Eureka Ave (hon 15.000 nguoi moi thang), dich vu phap ly nhap cu, nha phuc hoi Battle Born Housing Plus, ho tro tien thue/tien dien nuoc, giao bua an cho nguoi cao tuoi, phat trien luc luong lao dong va cac chuong trinh huong dan gia dinh.
vi.eligibility: Chào đón tất cả mọi người

organizations.name: Good Neighbors Warming Centers
organizations.description: Mutual aid warming centers for unhoused women and families, rotating weekly between four downtown churches (Trinity Episcopal, First United Methodist, Good Shepherd Lutheran, St. Thomas Aquinas). Open nightly 9 PM-6 AM from November through March. Provides cots, sleeping bags, hygiene supplies, light breakfast, and case management. Coordinated by Hampton House Garden and RISE.

contacts.value: 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM, 7 days/week during cold season

organizations.eligibility: Women, families, single dads with children. Single men directed to CARES Campus.

es.description: Centros de calentamiento de ayuda mutua para mujeres y familias sin hogar, rotando semanalmente entre cuatro iglesias del centro (Trinity Episcopal, First United Methodist, Good Shepherd Lutheran, St. Thomas Aquinas). Abierto de 9 PM a 6 AM de noviembre a marzo. Proporciona catres, sacos de dormir, artículos de higiene, desayuno ligero y gestión de casos. Coordinado por Hampton House Garden y RISE.
es.eligibility: Mujeres, familias, padres solteros con hijos. Hombres solos dirigidos al CARES Campus.

tl.description: Mutual aid warming centers para sa mga babaeng walang tirahan at pamilya, umiikot linggu-linggo sa apat na downtown churches (Trinity Episcopal, First United Methodist, Good Shepherd Lutheran, St. Thomas Aquinas). Bukas gabi-gabi 9 PM-6 AM mula Nobyembre hanggang Marso. Nagbibigay ng cots, sleeping bags, hygiene supplies, at case management. Koordinado ng Hampton House Garden at RISE.
tl.eligibility: Mga babae, pamilya, mga solo na tatay na may anak. Mga lalaking nag-iisa ay ididirekta sa CARES Campus.

zh.description: 面向无家可归女性和家庭的互助取暖中心，每周在四个市中心教堂轮流（Trinity Episcopal、First United Methodist、Good Shepherd Lutheran、St. Thomas Aquinas）。11月至3月每晚9点至早6点开放。提供床铺、睡袋、卫生用品、早餐和案例管理。由Hampton House Garden和RISE协调。
zh.eligibility: 女性、家庭、带孩子的单身父亲。单身男性请前往CARES Campus。

vi.description: Trung tâm sưởi ấm tương trợ cho phụ nữ và gia đình vô gia cư, luân phiên hàng tuần giữa bốn nhà thờ trung tâm (Trinity Episcopal, First United Methodist, Good Shepherd Lutheran, St. Thomas Aquinas). Mở hàng đêm 9 PM-6 AM từ tháng 11 đến tháng 3. Cung cấp giường gấp, túi ngủ, vật dụng vệ sinh, bữa sáng nhẹ và quản lý trường hợp. Phối hợp bởi Hampton House Garden và RISE.
vi.eligibility: Phụ nữ, gia đình, cha đơn thân có con. Nam giới độc thân được hướng dẫn đến CARES Campus.

organizations.name: Volunteers of America Nevada CARES Campus
organizations.description: Washoe County's comprehensive homeless services campus operated by Volunteers of America. Emergency shelter for 549+ adults, an 84-bed winter overflow area, Safe Camp (51 ModPod units), The Village (216 single-occupancy units), and a 50-unit permanent supportive housing building. Resource Center with meals, showers, laundry, case management, housing navigation, mental health counseling, and computer access. Low-barrier: guests may bring partners, pets, and possessions.

es.description: Campus integral de servicios para personas sin hogar del Condado de Washoe operado por Volunteers of America. Refugio de emergencia para 549+ adultos, 84 camas de desbordamiento invernal, Safe Camp (51 unidades ModPod), The Village (216 unidades individuales) y edificio de vivienda permanente de apoyo de 50 unidades. Centro de recursos con comidas, duchas, lavandería, gestión de casos, navegación de vivienda y consejería. Baja barrera: se permiten parejas, mascotas y pertenencias.

tl.description: Komprehensibong homeless services campus ng Washoe County na pinapatakbo ng Volunteers of America. Emergency shelter para sa 549+ adults, 84 na kama para sa winter overflow, Safe Camp (51 ModPod units), The Village (216 single-occupancy units), at 50-unit permanent supportive housing. Resource Center na may pagkain, shower, laundry, case management, housing navigation, at counseling. Low-barrier: pwedeng dalhin ang partner, pets, at gamit.

zh.description: 瓦肖县由美国志愿者组织运营的综合无家可归者服务园区。可容纳549+名成人的紧急庇护所、84张冬季溢出床位、Safe Camp（51个ModPod单元）、The Village（216个单人居住单元）和50单元永久支持性住房。资源中心提供餐食、淋浴、洗衣、案例管理、住房导航和咨询。低门槛：可携带伴侣、宠物和物品。

vi.description: Khuôn viên dịch vụ toàn diện cho người vô gia cư của Quận Washoe do Volunteers of America vận hành. Nơi trú ẩn khẩn cấp cho 549+ người lớn, 84 giường mùa đông, Safe Camp (51 đơn vị ModPod), The Village (216 đơn vị một người) và tòa nhà 50 đơn vị hỗ trợ lâu dài. Trung tâm tài nguyên với bữa ăn, tắm, giặt, quản lý trường hợp, hướng dẫn nhà ở và tư vấn. Ít rào cản: được mang bạn đời, thú cưng và đồ đạc.
vi.eligibility: Người lớn vô gia cư

organizations.name: CrossRoads Program (Washoe County HSA)
organizations.description: Washoe County HSA peer-led, alcohol and drug-free structured housing program with integrated wrap-around services. Serves men, women, women with children, and families through separate campuses operated in partnership with RISE. Provides case management, evidence-based life skills and workforce readiness curricula, behavioral healthcare linkages, and continuing care/alumni support (CROC). Free to participants.

contacts.value: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; drop-in pre-screening Tue/Wed/Thu 9 AM - 4 PM at 350 S. Center St.

organizations.eligibility: Men, women, women with children, and families seeking structured, supportive, alcohol and drug-free living

es.description: Programa de vivienda estructurada libre de alcohol y drogas del HSA del Condado de Washoe, dirigido por compañeros con servicios integrales. Sirve a hombres, mujeres, mujeres con hijos y familias en campus separados con RISE. Proporciona gestión de casos, habilidades de vida, preparación laboral, conexiones de salud y apoyo para exalumnos (CROC). Gratuito para participantes.
es.eligibility: Hombres, mujeres, mujeres con hijos y familias que buscan vivienda estructurada, de apoyo, libre de alcohol y drogas

tl.description: Washoe County HSA peer-led, walang alkohol at droga na structured housing program na may integrated wrap-around services. Nagsisilbi sa mga lalaki, babae, babae na may anak, at pamilya sa magkahiwalay na campus sa pakikipagtulungan ng RISE. Nagbibigay ng case management, life skills, workforce readiness, healthcare connections, at continuing care (CROC). Libre para sa participants.
tl.eligibility: Mga lalaki, babae, babae na may anak, at pamilya na naghahanap ng structured, supportive, walang alkohol at droga na tirahan

zh.description: 瓦肖县HSA同伴主导的无酒精和毒品结构化住房项目，配有综合服务。在与RISE合作的独立园区为男性、女性、带孩子的女性和家庭提供服务。提供案例管理、生活技能、就业准备、医疗对接和校友支持（CROC）。对参与者免费。
zh.eligibility: 寻求结构化、支持性、无酒精和毒品生活环境的男性、女性、带孩子的女性和家庭

vi.description: Chương trình nhà ở có cấu trúc không rượu và ma túy của HSA Quận Washoe, do đồng đẳng dẫn dắt với dịch vụ toàn diện. Phục vụ nam, nữ, phụ nữ có con và gia đình tại các khuôn viên riêng biệt cùng RISE. Cung cấp quản lý trường hợp, kỹ năng sống, đào tạo việc làm, kết nối y tế và hỗ trợ cựu thành viên (CROC). Miễn phí cho người tham gia.
vi.eligibility: Nam, nữ, phụ nữ có con và gia đình tìm kiếm nơi ở có cấu trúc, hỗ trợ, không rượu và ma túy

organizations.name: Battle Born Housing Plus (Catholic Charities)
organizations.description: Sober living transitional housing for up to 84 low-income men recovering from addiction, operated by Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada. First program in Nevada to earn National Recovery Residence certification (October 2025). Provides congregate living with shared kitchens, bathrooms, and laundry, plus individualized support plans including case management, substance use and mental health counseling, peer-to-peer support, on-site drug/alcohol testing, and employment support.
organizations.eligibility: Low-income men recovering from substance use disorder

es.description: Vivienda transicional de vida sobria para hasta 84 hombres de bajos ingresos en recuperación de adicción, operada por Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada. Primer programa en Nevada en obtener certificación Nacional de Residencia de Recuperación (octubre 2025). Vivienda congregada con cocinas, baños y lavandería compartidos, más planes de apoyo individualizados.
es.eligibility: Hombres de bajos ingresos en recuperación de trastorno por uso de sustancias

tl.description: Sober living transitional housing para sa hanggang 84 low-income na lalaki na nagre-recover mula sa addiction, pinapatakbo ng Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada. Unang programa sa Nevada na nakakuha ng National Recovery Residence certification (Oktubre 2025). Congregate living na may shared kitchens, bathrooms, at laundry, dagdag pa ang individualized support plans.
tl.eligibility: Low-income na lalaki na nagre-recover mula sa substance use disorder

zh.description: 为多达84名低收入男性成瘾康复者提供的清醒过渡住房，由北内华达天主教慈善机构运营。内华达州首个获得国家康复住所认证的项目（2025年10月）。集体生活配有共用厨房、浴室和洗衣设施，以及个性化支持计划。
zh.eligibility: 正在从药物滥用障碍中康复的低收入男性

vi.description: Nhà ở chuyển tiếp cai nghiện cho tối đa 84 nam giới thu nhập thấp đang phục hồi từ nghiện, do Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada vận hành. Chương trình đầu tiên tại Nevada đạt chứng nhận Quốc gia về Cư trú Phục hồi (tháng 10/2025). Sinh hoạt tập thể với nhà bếp, phòng tắm và giặt ủi chung, cùng kế hoạch hỗ trợ cá nhân.
vi.eligibility: Nam giới thu nhập thấp đang phục hồi từ rối loạn sử dụng chất

organizations.name: Hope Springs (Northern Nevada HOPES)
organizations.description: Northern Nevada's first bridge housing community - a 30-unit tiny home village providing intensive six-month transitional housing for people experiencing homelessness. Operated by Northern Nevada HOPES (a Federally Qualified Health Center). Residents receive single-occupancy units with privacy and locking doors, plus case management, medical and behavioral healthcare, mental health support, peer-led recovery meetings, life skills groups, and financial health services. Close to 50 residents have completed the program and moved into permanent housing.

contacts.value: New Applicant Orientation: Thursday 1-2 PM and Saturday 1-2 PM (excluding holidays)

es.description: Primera comunidad de vivienda puente del norte de Nevada - una villa de 30 casas diminutas que proporciona vivienda transicional intensiva de seis meses. Operada por Northern Nevada HOPES (Centro de Salud Federalmente Calificado). Unidades de ocupación individual con privacidad y puertas con llave, más gestión de casos, atención médica y de salud conductual, y servicios de salud financiera. Cerca de 50 residentes han completado el programa.

tl.description: Unang bridge housing community ng Hilagang Nevada - 30-unit tiny home village na nagbibigay ng intensive na anim na buwang transitional housing. Pinapatakbo ng Northern Nevada HOPES (Federally Qualified Health Center). Single-occupancy units na may privacy at naka-lock na pinto, dagdag pa ang case management, medical at behavioral healthcare, at financial health services. Halos 50 residente ang nakatapos ng programa.
tl.eligibility: Mga adult na walang tirahan (30-60 taun-taon)

zh.description: 北内华达州首个过渡住房社区——提供六个月密集过渡住房的30单元微型住宅村。由Northern Nevada HOPES（联邦合格健康中心）运营。单人居住单元配有隐私和上锁门，提供案例管理、医疗和行为健康护理以及财务健康服务。近50名居民已完成项目。
zh.eligibility: 无家可归的成年人（每年30-60人）

vi.description: Cộng đồng nhà ở cầu nối đầu tiên của Bắc Nevada - làng nhà nhỏ 30 đơn vị cung cấp nhà ở chuyển tiếp sáu tháng chuyên sâu. Do Northern Nevada HOPES (Trung tâm Y tế Đủ điều kiện Liên bang) vận hành. Đơn vị một người với riêng tư và cửa khóa, cùng quản lý trường hợp, chăm sóc y tế và hành vi, và dịch vụ tài chính. Gần 50 cư dân đã hoàn thành chương trình.
vi.eligibility: Người lớn vô gia cư (30-60 người/năm)

organizations.name: Safe Camp
organizations.description: A 51-unit ModPod tiny home village adjacent to the Nevada CARES Campus, providing non-congregate housing for adults who cannot succeed in group shelter settings. Each 8x8-foot insulated unit has a locking door, HVAC, electricity, bed, and shelves. Residents receive two meals daily, snacks, water, and case management focused on permanent housing placement. Operated by the Karma Box Project under contract with Washoe County. Couples, single adults 18+, and pets accepted; sobriety not required. Referral-based admission only.

contacts.value: 100 Cares Drive, Reno, NV 89512 (adjacent to Nevada CARES Campus)

es.description: Villa de 51 unidades ModPod adyacente al CARES Campus, proporcionando vivienda no congregada para adultos que no pueden tener éxito en refugios grupales. Cada unidad tiene puerta con llave, HVAC, electricidad, cama y estantes. Dos comidas diarias más gestión de casos. Operado por Karma Box Project. Parejas, adultos 18+ y mascotas aceptados; sobriedad no requerida. Solo admisión por referencia.
es.eligibility: Adultos en programa de vivienda transicional

tl.description: 51-unit na ModPod tiny home village katabi ng CARES Campus, nagbibigay ng non-congregate housing para sa mga adult na hindi kayang mag-succeed sa group shelter. Bawat unit may naka-lock na pinto, HVAC, kuryente, kama, at estante. Dalawang pagkain araw-araw dagdag ang case management. Pinapatakbo ng Karma Box Project. Tinatanggap ang mga mag-asawa, solo adults 18+, at pets; hindi kailangan ang sobriety. Referral-based admission lamang.
tl.eligibility: Mga adult sa transitional housing program

zh.description: 毗邻CARES Campus的51单元ModPod微型住宅村，为无法适应集体庇护的成人提供非集中住房。每个单元有上锁门、暖通空调、电力、床和架子。每天两餐加案例管理。由Karma Box Project运营。接受夫妻、18+成人和宠物；不要求戒酒。仅通过转介入住。
zh.eligibility: 过渡性住房项目中的成年人

vi.description: Làng nhà nhỏ ModPod 51 đơn vị liền kề CARES Campus, cung cấp nhà ở không tập trung cho người lớn không thể ở nơi trú ẩn nhóm. Mỗi đơn vị có cửa khóa, HVAC, điện, giường và kệ. Hai bữa ăn/ngày cùng quản lý trường hợp. Do Karma Box Project vận hành. Chấp nhận cặp đôi, người lớn 18+ và thú cưng; không yêu cầu kiêng rượu. Chỉ nhận qua giới thiệu.
vi.eligibility: Người lớn trong chương trình nhà ở chuyển tiếp

organizations.name: Eddy House
organizations.description: Northern Nevada's central resource center for homeless, runaway, foster, and at-risk youth ages 12-24. Provides emergency shelter, transitional housing (TLC 360 apartments), counseling, meals, clothing, workforce development, and life skills training. Extensive outreach in downtown Reno to connect youth with services.

es.description: Centro de recursos central del norte de Nevada para jóvenes sin hogar, fugitivos, de cuidado temporal y en riesgo de 12 a 24 años. Proporciona refugio de emergencia, vivienda transicional (apartamentos TLC 360), consejería, comidas, ropa, desarrollo laboral y capacitación en habilidades de vida.

tl.description: Central resource center ng Hilagang Nevada para sa homeless, runaway, foster, at at-risk na kabataan edad 12-24. Nagbibigay ng emergency shelter, transitional housing (TLC 360 apartments), counseling, pagkain, damit, workforce development, at life skills training.

zh.description: 北内华达州面向12-24岁无家可归、离家出走、寄养和高风险青年的中央资源中心。提供紧急庇护、过渡住房（TLC 360公寓）、咨询、餐食、服装、就业发展和生活技能培训。

vi.description: Trung tâm tài nguyên chính của Bắc Nevada cho thanh thiếu niên vô gia cư, bỏ nhà, chăm sóc thay thế và có nguy cơ từ 12-24 tuổi. Cung cấp nơi trú ẩn khẩn cấp, nhà ở chuyển tiếp (căn hộ TLC 360), tư vấn, bữa ăn, quần áo, phát triển nghề nghiệp và đào tạo kỹ năng sống.

organizations.name: Our Place / RISE
organizations.description: Low-barrier, housing-first emergency shelter for women, families, seniors, and their animal companions, operated by RISE (Reno Initiative for Shelter & Equality) in partnership with Washoe County HSA. Campus of renovated buildings currently sheltering 138 women, 38 families, and 28 seniors. Open 24/7 with harm reduction focus and minimal entry requirements.

es.description: Refugio de emergencia de baja barrera, vivienda primero para mujeres, familias, personas mayores y sus animales, operado por RISE en asociación con Washoe County HSA. Campus de edificios renovados que alberga 138 mujeres, 38 familias y 28 personas mayores. Abierto 24/7 con enfoque de reducción de daños.

tl.description: Low-barrier, housing-first emergency shelter para sa mga babae, pamilya, matatanda, at kanilang mga hayop, pinapatakbo ng RISE sa pakikipagtulungan ng Washoe County HSA. Campus ng mga renovated buildings na kasalukuyang nagsi-shelter ng 138 babae, 38 pamilya, at 28 matatanda. Bukas 24/7 na may harm reduction focus.

zh.description: 由RISE与瓦肖县HSA合作运营的低门槛、住房优先紧急庇护所，为女性、家庭、老年人及其动物伴侣提供服务。翻新建筑园区目前庇护138名女性、38个家庭和28名老年人。24/7开放，以减害为重点。

vi.description: Nơi trú ẩn khẩn cấp ít rào cản, ưu tiên nhà ở cho phụ nữ, gia đình, người cao tuổi và thú cưng, do RISE vận hành cùng Washoe County HSA. Khuôn viên tòa nhà được cải tạo hiện đang che chở 138 phụ nữ, 38 gia đình và 28 người cao tuổi. Mở 24/7 với trọng tâm giảm hại.

organizations.name: Nevada Youth Empowerment Project (NYEP)
organizations.description: Community-based residential program for homeless young women ages 18-24, providing structured independent living through the Community Living Program (CLP). Offers housing, daily life skills curriculum developed with a behavioral psychologist, job training, and family-like support. Sonder House provides affordable post-program housing ($300/month including utilities). 100% community funded. Has served over 140 young women since 2007.

es.description: Programa residencial comunitario para mujeres jóvenes sin hogar de 18 a 24 años, proporcionando vida independiente estructurada. Ofrece vivienda, currículo de habilidades de vida, capacitación laboral y apoyo familiar. Sonder House ofrece vivienda post-programa ($300/mes). 100% financiado por la comunidad. Ha servido a más de 140 mujeres jóvenes desde 2007.

tl.description: Community-based residential program para sa homeless na young women edad 18-24, nagbibigay ng structured independent living. Nag-aalok ng tirahan, daily life skills curriculum, job training, at family-like support. Ang Sonder House ay nagbibigay ng affordable post-program housing ($300/buwan). 100% community funded. Nagsilbi sa mahigit 140 na young women mula 2007.

zh.description: 面向18-24岁无家可归年轻女性的社区住宅项目，提供结构化独立生活。提供住房、日常生活技能课程、工作培训和家庭式支持。Sonder House提供$300/月的后续住房。100%社区资助。自2007年以来已服务140多名年轻女性。

vi.description: Chương trình cư trú cộng đồng cho phụ nữ trẻ vô gia cư 18-24 tuổi, cung cấp sinh hoạt độc lập có cấu trúc. Cung cấp nhà ở, chương trình kỹ năng sống, đào tạo việc làm và hỗ trợ gia đình. Sonder House cung cấp nhà ở sau chương trình ($300/tháng). 100% tài trợ cộng đồng. Đã phục vụ hơn 140 phụ nữ trẻ từ 2007.

organizations.name: Karma Box Project
organizations.description: Nonprofit operating community goodwill boxes across Reno and Washoe County stocked with hygiene items, non-perishable food, first aid, and menstrual supplies for people experiencing homelessness. Also operates Safe Camp (51-unit tiny home village at Nevada CARES Campus) under contract with Washoe County, providing housing, case management, and permanent housing placement. Founded by Grant Denton in 2018.

contacts.value: 100 N Arlington Ave Suite 250, Reno, NV 89501

es.description: Organización sin fines de lucro que opera cajas de buena voluntad comunitarias en Reno y el Condado de Washoe con artículos de higiene, alimentos no perecederos, primeros auxilios y suministros menstruales. También opera Safe Camp (villa de 51 casas diminutas en CARES Campus) bajo contrato con el Condado de Washoe. Fundada por Grant Denton en 2018.

tl.description: Nonprofit na nagpapatakbo ng community goodwill boxes sa Reno at Washoe County na may hygiene items, non-perishable food, first aid, at menstrual supplies. Pinapatakbo din ang Safe Camp (51-unit tiny home village sa CARES Campus) sa ilalim ng kontrata sa Washoe County. Itinatag ni Grant Denton noong 2018.

zh.description: 在里诺和瓦肖县运营社区善意箱的非营利组织，提供卫生用品、不易腐烂食品、急救用品和经期用品。还运营Safe Camp（CARES Campus的51单元微型住宅村），与瓦肖县签约。由Grant Denton于2018年创立。

vi.description: Tổ chức phi lợi nhuận vận hành hộp thiện chí cộng đồng tại Reno và Quận Washoe với đồ vệ sinh, thực phẩm không dễ hỏng, sơ cứu và vật dụng kinh nguyệt. Cũng vận hành Safe Camp (làng nhà nhỏ 51 đơn vị tại CARES Campus) theo hợp đồng với Quận Washoe. Được Grant Denton thành lập năm 2018.

organizations.name: P.U.F. House (WellCare Foundation)
organizations.description: Psychiatric Urgent Facility (PUF) and medical/behavioral health clinic operated by WC Health (formerly WellCare Foundation). Drop-in resource center accepting walk-ins, hospital discharges, and community referrals for psychiatric assessment and linkage to outpatient mental health services, including same-day outpatient appointments. Also operates a Community Triage Center (CTC) providing crisis stabilization and medical detox.

es.description: Instalación Psiquiátrica Urgente (PUF) y clínica de salud conductual operada por WC Health (anteriormente WellCare Foundation). Centro de recursos sin cita previa que acepta visitas directas, altas hospitalarias y referencias comunitarias para evaluación psiquiátrica y vinculación con servicios ambulatorios. También opera un Centro de Triaje Comunitario (CTC) para estabilización de crisis y desintoxicación médica.

tl.description: Psychiatric Urgent Facility (PUF) at medical/behavioral health clinic na pinapatakbo ng WC Health (dating WellCare Foundation). Drop-in resource center na tumatanggap ng walk-ins, hospital discharges, at community referrals para sa psychiatric assessment at linkage sa outpatient services. Pinapatakbo din ang Community Triage Center (CTC) para sa crisis stabilization at medical detox.

zh.description: WC Health（前WellCare Foundation）运营的精神科紧急设施（PUF）和行为健康诊所。接受无预约来访、出院转介和社区转介的就诊资源中心，提供精神评估和门诊服务对接。还运营社区分流中心（CTC）提供危机稳定和医疗戒毒。

vi.description: Cơ sở Tâm thần Khẩn cấp (PUF) và phòng khám sức khỏe hành vi do WC Health (trước đây là WellCare Foundation) vận hành. Trung tâm tài nguyên nhận người đến không hẹn, xuất viện và giới thiệu cộng đồng để đánh giá tâm thần và kết nối dịch vụ ngoại trú. Cũng vận hành Trung tâm Phân loại Cộng đồng (CTC) cho ổn định khủng hoảng và cai nghiện y tế.

organizations.name: The Life Change Center
organizations.description: Nonprofit opioid treatment program (OTP) providing methadone maintenance, medication management, structured counseling, and holistic recovery services since 1998. CARF-accredited. Services include substance use counseling, mental health support, peer mentoring, employment training, case management, and family resources. Also distributes free Narcan and fentanyl test strips. Additional locations in Sparks and Carson City.

contacts.value: Mon-Fri 6:00 AM - 12:45 PM and 4:30 PM - 7:45 PM; Intakes Mon/Wed at 6 AM and Tue/Thu at 4:30 PM

es.description: Programa de tratamiento con opioides (OTP) sin fines de lucro que proporciona mantenimiento con metadona, gestión de medicamentos, consejería y servicios de recuperación desde 1998. Acreditado por CARF. Incluye consejería de uso de sustancias, apoyo de salud mental, mentoría, capacitación laboral y recursos familiares. Distribuye Narcan y tiras de prueba de fentanilo. Ubicaciones adicionales en Sparks y Carson City.

tl.description: Nonprofit opioid treatment program (OTP) na nagbibigay ng methadone maintenance, medication management, counseling, at recovery services mula 1998. CARF-accredited. Kasama ang substance use counseling, mental health support, peer mentoring, employment training, at family resources. Namamahagi din ng libreng Narcan at fentanyl test strips. May dagdag na lokasyon sa Sparks at Carson City.

zh.description: 自1998年以来提供美沙酮维持、药物管理、咨询和整体康复服务的非营利阿片类治疗项目（OTP）。获CARF认证。包括物质使用咨询、心理健康支持、同伴辅导、就业培训和家庭资源。免费发放Narcan和芬太尼试纸。在Sparks和Carson City设有额外地点。

vi.description: Chương trình điều trị opioid phi lợi nhuận (OTP) cung cấp duy trì methadone, quản lý thuốc, tư vấn và dịch vụ phục hồi từ 1998. Được CARF chứng nhận. Bao gồm tư vấn sử dụng chất, hỗ trợ sức khỏe tâm thần, cố vấn đồng đẳng, đào tạo việc làm và tài nguyên gia đình. Phân phát miễn phí Narcan và que thử fentanyl. Thêm địa điểm tại Sparks và Carson City.

organizations.name: Reno Housing Authority
organizations.description: Public housing authority providing affordable housing for low-income families across Washoe County. Owns and operates 756 affordable housing units and administers the Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) program with 2,955 vouchers. Walk-in housing specialist available (no appointment needed).

es.description: Autoridad de vivienda pública que proporciona vivienda asequible para familias de bajos ingresos en el Condado de Washoe. Posee y opera 756 unidades de vivienda asequible y administra el programa de Vouchers de Elección de Vivienda (Sección 8) con 2,955 vouchers. Especialista de vivienda disponible sin cita previa.

tl.description: Public housing authority na nagbibigay ng affordable housing para sa low-income na pamilya sa Washoe County. Nagmamay-ari at nagpapatakbo ng 756 affordable housing units at nag-aadminister ng Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) program na may 2,955 vouchers. Walk-in housing specialist available.

zh.description: 为瓦肖县低收入家庭提供经济适用房的公共住房管理局。拥有并运营756个经济适用房单元，管理2,955张住房选择券（第8条）计划。提供无需预约的住房专家服务。

vi.description: Cơ quan nhà ở công cộng cung cấp nhà ở giá phải chăng cho gia đình thu nhập thấp tại Quận Washoe. Sở hữu và vận hành 756 đơn vị nhà ở và quản lý chương trình Phiếu Chọn Nhà ở (Mục 8) với 2.955 phiếu. Chuyên gia nhà ở sẵn sàng không cần hẹn.
vi.eligibility: Dựa trên thu nhập

organizations.name: Safe Embrace
organizations.description: Reno-Sparks area's largest safe house for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking. Provides 90-day emergency shelter (9 beds), 12-month transitional housing (30 beds), and rapid rehousing. Services include 24-hour crisis hotline, safety planning, advocacy, therapy for adults and children, weekly survivor support groups, court support, emergency transportation, and prevention education. Only local shelter with trained and certified sexual assault advocates. Accepts survivors with their pets and children.

contacts.value: 220 S Rock Blvd, Suite 7, Reno, NV 89502

es.description: La casa segura más grande del área Reno-Sparks para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, agresión sexual y tráfico humano. Proporciona refugio de emergencia de 90 días (9 camas), vivienda transicional de 12 meses (30 camas) y realojamiento rápido. Servicios incluyen línea de crisis 24 horas, planificación de seguridad, defensa, terapia, grupos de apoyo para sobrevivientes, apoyo judicial y educación preventiva. Acepta sobrevivientes con mascotas e hijos.

tl.description: Pinakamalaking safe house sa Reno-Sparks para sa mga survivor ng domestic violence, sexual assault, at human trafficking. Nagbibigay ng 90-araw emergency shelter (9 kama), 12-buwan transitional housing (30 kama), at rapid rehousing. Kasama sa mga serbisyo ang 24-hour crisis hotline, safety planning, advocacy, therapy, survivor support groups, court support, at prevention education. Tinatanggap ang mga survivor kasama ang kanilang pets at anak.

zh.description: 里诺-斯帕克斯地区最大的家庭暴力、性侵犯和人口贩卖幸存者安全屋。提供90天紧急庇护（9张床）、12个月过渡住房（30张床）和快速安置。服务包括24小时危机热线、安全规划、倡导、治疗、幸存者支持小组、法庭支持和预防教育。接受幸存者携带宠物和儿童。
zh.eligibility: 家庭暴力/性暴力幸存者

vi.description: Nhà an toàn lớn nhất vùng Reno-Sparks cho người sống sót sau bạo lực gia đình, tấn công tình dục và buôn người. Cung cấp nơi trú ẩn khẩn cấp 90 ngày (9 giường), nhà ở chuyển tiếp 12 tháng (30 giường) và tái ổn cư nhanh. Dịch vụ bao gồm đường dây khủng hoảng 24h, lập kế hoạch an toàn, vận động, trị liệu, nhóm hỗ trợ, hỗ trợ tòa án và giáo dục phòng ngừa. Chấp nhận người sống sót cùng thú cưng và con cái.
vi.eligibility: Người sống sót sau bạo lực gia đình/tình dục

organizations.name: SafeLink Wireless
organizations.description: Federal Lifeline program providing free smartphones with free monthly service (350 minutes, unlimited texts, 3GB data) to income-eligible individuals. Qualifying criteria: household income at or below 135% of Federal Poverty Level, or participation in Medicaid, SNAP, SSI, or other federal assistance programs. One benefit per household. Apply online or by phone.
organizations.eligibility: Income-based or participation in government programs (SNAP, Medicaid, etc.)

es.description: Programa federal Lifeline que proporciona smartphones gratuitos con servicio mensual gratuito (350 minutos, textos ilimitados, 3GB datos) para personas elegibles por ingresos. Requisitos: ingreso del hogar igual o inferior al 135% del nivel federal de pobreza, o participación en Medicaid, SNAP, SSI u otros programas. Solicite en línea o por teléfono.
es.eligibility: Basado en ingresos o participación en programas gubernamentales (SNAP, Medicaid, etc.)

tl.description: Federal Lifeline program na nagbibigay ng libreng smartphone na may libreng buwanang serbisyo (350 minuto, unlimited texts, 3GB data) para sa income-eligible na indibidwal. Kwalipikasyon: income ng sambahayan na 135% o mas mababa ng Federal Poverty Level, o paglahok sa Medicaid, SNAP, SSI, o iba pang programa. Mag-apply online o sa telepono.
tl.eligibility: Batay sa kita o paglahok sa mga programa ng gobyerno (SNAP, Medicaid, atbp.)

zh.description: 联邦Lifeline计划为收入合格个人提供免费智能手机和免费月服务（350分钟、无限短信、3GB数据）。资格要求：家庭收入不超过联邦贫困线135%，或参加Medicaid、SNAP、SSI等联邦援助计划。在线或电话申请。
zh.eligibility: 基于收入或参加政府项目（SNAP、Medicaid等）

vi.description: Chương trình Lifeline liên bang cung cấp điện thoại thông minh miễn phí với dịch vụ hàng tháng miễn phí (350 phút, tin nhắn không giới hạn, 3GB dữ liệu) cho cá nhân đủ điều kiện thu nhập. Yêu cầu: thu nhập hộ gia đình bằng hoặc dưới 135% mức nghèo liên bang, hoặc tham gia Medicaid, SNAP, SSI. Đăng ký trực tuyến hoặc qua điện thoại.
vi.eligibility: Dựa trên thu nhập hoặc tham gia chương trình chính phủ (SNAP, Medicaid, v.v.)

organizations.name: Nevada Legal Services
organizations.description: Nonprofit law firm providing free civil legal aid to low-income Nevadans. Handles housing disputes, eviction defense, record sealing, benefits denials (SNAP, TANF, unemployment, Social Security), consumer issues, bankruptcy, immigration, and name changes. Operates a Tenants' Rights Center with a dedicated phone line for rental issues including eviction defense and lease disputes. Also runs the Senior Law Project and Consumer Law Project.

contacts.value: 449 S Virginia St, 3rd Floor, Reno, NV 89501

es.description: Firma de abogados sin fines de lucro que proporciona asistencia legal civil gratuita a nevadenses de bajos ingresos. Maneja disputas de vivienda, defensa contra desalojo, sellado de antecedentes, denegaciones de beneficios (SNAP, TANF, desempleo, Seguro Social), problemas del consumidor, bancarrota, inmigracion y cambios de nombre. Opera un Centro de Derechos del Inquilino con una linea telefonica dedicada para problemas de alquiler, incluida la defensa contra desalojo y disputas de arrendamiento. Tambien dirige el Proyecto de Ley para Personas Mayores y el Proyecto de Ley del Consumidor.
es.eligibility: Basado en ingresos (por debajo del 200% del nivel federal de pobreza)

tl.description: Nonprofit na law firm na nagbibigay ng libreng sibil na legal na tulong sa mga mababang-kita na taga-Nevada. Humahawak ng mga housing disputes, eviction defense, record sealing, benefits denials (SNAP, TANF, unemployment, Social Security), consumer issues, bankruptcy, immigration, at name changes. Nagpapatakbo ng Tenants' Rights Center na may dedicated phone line para sa rental issues kasama ang eviction defense at lease disputes. Nagpapatakbo rin ng Senior Law Project at Consumer Law Project.
tl.eligibility: Batay sa kita (mas mababa sa 200% FPL)

zh.description: 非营利律师事务所，为低收入内华达州居民提供免费民事法律援助。处理住房纠纷、驱逐辩护、记录封存、福利拒绝（SNAP、TANF、失业金、社会保障）、消费者问题、破产、移民和姓名变更。运营租户权利中心，设有专门电话线处理租赁问题，包括驱逐辩护和租约纠纷。还运营老年法律项目和消费者法律项目。
zh.eligibility: 基于收入（低于联邦贫困线200%）

vi.description: Cong ty luat phi loi nhuan cung cap tro giup phap ly dan su mien phi cho cu dan Nevada co thu nhap thap. Xu ly tranh chap nha o, bao ve chong truc xuat, niem phong ho so, tu choi phuc loi (SNAP, TANF, that nghiep, An sinh Xa hoi), van de nguoi tieu dung, pha san, nhap cu va doi ten. Van hanh Trung tam Quyen Nguoi thue voi duong day dien thoai rieng cho cac van de thue nha bao gom bao ve chong truc xuat va tranh chap hop dong thue. Cung dieu hanh Du an Luat Nguoi cao tuoi va Du an Luat Nguoi tieu dung.
vi.eligibility: Dựa trên thu nhập (dưới 200% mức nghèo liên bang)

organizations.name: Northern Nevada Legal Aid
organizations.description: Nonprofit legal aid organization serving 11 Northern Nevada counties including Washoe County, providing free civil legal assistance on over 10,500 matters annually. Services include housing, family law for domestic violence victims, adult guardianship, child advocacy, immigration, the Civil Law Self-Help Center, a Senior Legal Center for residents 60+, and medical-legal partnerships.

es.description: Organizacion de asistencia legal sin fines de lucro que sirve a 11 condados del norte de Nevada, incluido el condado de Washoe, proporcionando asistencia legal civil gratuita en mas de 10,500 asuntos anualmente. Los servicios incluyen vivienda, derecho familiar para victimas de violencia domestica, tutela de adultos, defensa de menores, inmigracion, el Centro de Autoayuda de Ley Civil, un Centro Legal para Personas Mayores para residentes de 60+ anos y asociaciones medico-legales.

tl.description: Nonprofit legal aid organization na nagsisilbi sa 11 Northern Nevada counties kasama ang Washoe County, nagbibigay ng libreng sibil na legal na tulong sa mahigit 10,500 na bagay taon-taon. Kasama sa mga serbisyo ang housing, family law para sa mga biktima ng domestic violence, adult guardianship, child advocacy, immigration, ang Civil Law Self-Help Center, isang Senior Legal Center para sa mga residenteng 60+, at medical-legal partnerships.

zh.description: 非营利法律援助组织，服务包括沃肖县在内的北内华达州11个县，每年提供10,500多件免费民事法律援助。服务包括住房、家暴受害者家庭法、成人监护、儿童权益倡导、移民、民事法律自助中心、60岁以上居民的老年法律中心和医疗法律伙伴关系。

vi.description: To chuc tro giup phap ly phi loi nhuan phuc vu 11 quan Bac Nevada bao gom quan Washoe, cung cap tro giup phap ly dan su mien phi cho hon 10.500 vu viec hang nam. Dich vu bao gom nha o, luat gia dinh cho nan nhan bao luc gia dinh, giam ho nguoi lon, bao ve tre em, nhap cu, Trung tam Tu giup Luat Dan su, Trung tam Phap ly Nguoi cao tuoi cho cu dan tu 60 tuoi va quan he doi tac y te-phap ly.
vi.eligibility: Dựa trên thu nhập

organizations.name: Northern Nevada HOPES
organizations.description: Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) and Patient-Centered Medical Home providing affordable, integrated healthcare to over 17,000 patients annually at two downtown Reno locations. Services include adult and pediatric primary care, behavioral health, substance use treatment, medication-assisted treatment (MAT), HIV/AIDS care, sexual health, LGBTQ+ affirming care, pharmacy, maternal health, case management, and transportation. Founded in 1997 as northern Nevada's first HIV clinic, serving everyone regardless of insurance or ability to pay.

es.description: Centro de Salud Calificado Federalmente (FQHC) y Hogar Medico Centrado en el Paciente que brinda atencion medica integrada y asequible a mas de 17,000 pacientes anualmente en dos ubicaciones en el centro de Reno. Los servicios incluyen atencion primaria para adultos y pediatrica, salud mental, tratamiento de uso de sustancias, tratamiento asistido con medicamentos (MAT), atencion de VIH/SIDA, salud sexual, atencion afirmativa LGBTQ+, farmacia, salud materna, manejo de casos y transporte. Fundado en 1997 como la primera clinica de VIH del norte de Nevada, atiende a todos independientemente del seguro o capacidad de pago.

tl.description: Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) at Patient-Centered Medical Home na nagbibigay ng abot-kayang integrated healthcare sa mahigit 17,000 pasyente taon-taon sa dalawang lokasyon sa downtown Reno. Kasama sa mga serbisyo ang adult at pediatric primary care, behavioral health, substance use treatment, medication-assisted treatment (MAT), HIV/AIDS care, sexual health, LGBTQ+ affirming care, pharmacy, maternal health, case management, at transportasyon. Itinatag noong 1997 bilang unang HIV clinic ng northern Nevada, nagsisilbi sa lahat anuman ang insurance o kakayahang magbayad.

zh.description: 联邦合格健康中心（FQHC）和以患者为中心的医疗之家，在里诺市中心两个地点每年为17,000多名患者提供平价综合医疗服务。服务包括成人和儿科初级保健、行为健康、药物使用治疗、药物辅助治疗（MAT）、HIV/AIDS护理、性健康、LGBTQ+肯定护理、药房、产妇健康、个案管理和交通。1997年作为北内华达州第一家HIV诊所成立，为所有人提供服务，不论保险或支付能力。

vi.description: Trung tam Suc khoe Du dieu kien Lien bang (FQHC) va Nha Y te Lay Benh nhan lam Trung tam, cung cap cham soc suc khoe tich hop gia ca phai chang cho hon 17.000 benh nhan hang nam tai hai dia diem o trung tam Reno. Dich vu bao gom cham soc ban dau nguoi lon va nhi khoa, suc khoe hanh vi, dieu tri su dung chat, dieu tri ho tro bang thuoc (MAT), cham soc HIV/AIDS, suc khoe tinh duc, cham soc khang dinh LGBTQ+, duoc pham, suc khoe ba me, quan ly truong hop va van chuyen. Thanh lap nam 1997 la phong kham HIV dau tien cua bac Nevada, phuc vu tat ca moi nguoi bat ke bao hiem hay kha nang chi tra.
vi.eligibility: Phí theo thang trượt

organizations.name: Northern Nevada HOPES - Sexual Health
organizations.description: Comprehensive sexual healthcare clinic at Northern Nevada HOPES offering STI testing and treatment, rapid HIV and Hepatitis C testing, PrEP and PEP for HIV prevention, family planning and contraception, and gender-affirming care. Walk-in STI testing is available at both locations. Free safer sex kits and naloxone/Narcan available. Accepts insurance, Medicaid, Medicare, and sliding fee scale for uninsured.

es.description: Clinica de salud sexual integral en Northern Nevada HOPES que ofrece pruebas y tratamiento de ETS, pruebas rapidas de VIH y Hepatitis C, PrEP y PEP para prevencion del VIH, planificacion familiar y anticoncepcion, y atencion de afirmacion de genero. Pruebas de ETS sin cita disponibles en ambas ubicaciones. Kits de sexo seguro y naloxona/Narcan gratuitos disponibles. Acepta seguro, Medicaid, Medicare y escala de tarifas deslizante para no asegurados.

tl.description: Komprehensibong sexual healthcare clinic sa Northern Nevada HOPES na nag-aalok ng STI testing at paggamot, mabilis na HIV at Hepatitis C testing, PrEP at PEP para sa HIV prevention, family planning at contraception, at gender-affirming care. Walk-in STI testing ay available sa parehong lokasyon. Libreng safer sex kits at naloxone/Narcan available. Tumatanggap ng insurance, Medicaid, Medicare, at sliding fee scale para sa walang insurance.

zh.description: Northern Nevada HOPES的综合性健康诊所，提供性病检测和治疗、快速HIV和丙肝检测、HIV预防（PrEP和PEP）、计划生育和避孕以及性别肯定护理。两个地点均提供免预约性病检测。免费提供安全性行为工具包和纳洛酮/Narcan。接受保险、Medicaid、Medicare和无保险者滑动收费标准。

vi.description: Phong kham suc khoe tinh duc toan dien tai Northern Nevada HOPES cung cap xet nghiem va dieu tri STI, xet nghiem nhanh HIV va Viem gan C, PrEP va PEP phong ngua HIV, ke hoach hoa gia dinh va tranh thai, va cham soc khang dinh gioi tinh. Xet nghiem STI khong can hen tai ca hai dia diem. Bo dung cu tinh duc an toan va naloxone/Narcan mien phi. Chap nhan bao hiem, Medicaid, Medicare va thang phi truot cho nguoi khong co bao hiem.
vi.eligibility: Chào đón tất cả mọi người

organizations.name: Community Health Alliance
organizations.description: Nonprofit federally qualified health center (FQHC) with seven locations across Reno and Sparks, providing affordable medical, dental, behavioral health, reproductive health, and pharmacy services on a sliding fee scale. Also offers WIC, a Prescription Food Pantry, immunizations, chronic disease management, and insurance enrollment assistance. Accepts Medicaid, Medicare, private insurance, and serves uninsured patients regardless of ability to pay.

es.description: Centro de salud comunitario calificado federalmente (FQHC) sin fines de lucro con siete ubicaciones en Reno y Sparks, que brinda servicios medicos, dentales, de salud mental, salud reproductiva y farmacia asequibles con escala de tarifas deslizante. Tambien ofrece WIC, despensa de alimentos con receta, vacunaciones, manejo de enfermedades cronicas y asistencia para inscripcion en seguros. Acepta Medicaid, Medicare, seguro privado y atiende a pacientes sin seguro independientemente de su capacidad de pago.

tl.description: Nonprofit na federally qualified health center (FQHC) na may pitong lokasyon sa Reno at Sparks, na nagbibigay ng abot-kayang medikal, dental, behavioral health, reproductive health, at serbisyong parmasyutiko sa sliding fee scale. Nag-aalok din ng WIC, Prescription Food Pantry, immunizations, pamamahala ng malalang sakit, at tulong sa insurance enrollment. Tumatanggap ng Medicaid, Medicare, pribadong insurance, at nagsisilbi sa mga walang insurance anuman ang kakayahang magbayad.

zh.description: 非营利联邦合格健康中心（FQHC），在里诺和斯帕克斯设有七个地点，以滑动收费标准提供平价医疗、牙科、行为健康、生殖健康和药房服务。还提供WIC、处方食品储藏室、免疫接种、慢性病管理和保险登记援助。接受Medicaid、Medicare、私人保险，并为无保险患者提供服务，不论支付能力。

vi.description: Trung tam suc khoe du dieu kien lien bang (FQHC) phi loi nhuan voi bay dia diem tai Reno va Sparks, cung cap dich vu y te, nha khoa, suc khoe hanh vi, suc khoe sinh san va duoc pham gia ca phai chang theo thang phi truot. Cung cung cap WIC, Nha thuoc thuc pham theo don, tiem chung, quan ly benh man tinh va ho tro dang ky bao hiem. Chap nhan Medicaid, Medicare, bao hiem tu nhan va phuc vu benh nhan khong co bao hiem bat ke kha nang chi tra.
vi.eligibility: Không có bảo hiểm/bảo hiểm không đủ

organizations.name: Change Point
organizations.description: Harm reduction program formerly operated by Northern Nevada HOPES, with syringe exchange and street outreach services now transitioned to the Northern Nevada Harm Reduction Alliance (NNVHRA). HOPES continues to provide sharps disposal at their 5th Street location, rapid HIV/Hep C testing, and same-day STI testing through their clinic. NNVHRA distributes supplies at the HOPES parking lot Saturdays 3-4pm and at Family Soup/Believe Plaza Tuesdays 5-6pm.

es.description: Programa de reduccion de danos anteriormente operado por Northern Nevada HOPES, con servicios de intercambio de jeringas y alcance callejero ahora transferidos a la Northern Nevada Harm Reduction Alliance (NNVHRA). HOPES continua proporcionando eliminacion de objetos punzantes en su ubicacion de 5th Street, pruebas rapidas de VIH/Hepatitis C y pruebas de ETS el mismo dia. NNVHRA distribuye suministros en el estacionamiento de HOPES los sabados de 3-4pm y en Family Soup/Believe Plaza los martes de 5-6pm.

tl.description: Harm reduction program na dating pinapatakbo ng Northern Nevada HOPES, na ang syringe exchange at street outreach services ay inilipat na sa Northern Nevada Harm Reduction Alliance (NNVHRA). Patuloy na nagbibigay ang HOPES ng sharps disposal sa kanilang 5th Street location, mabilis na HIV/Hep C testing, at same-day STI testing. Namamahagi ang NNVHRA ng supplies sa HOPES parking lot tuwing Sabado 3-4pm at sa Family Soup/Believe Plaza tuwing Martes 5-6pm.

zh.description: 原由Northern Nevada HOPES运营的减害项目，注射器交换和街头外展服务现已转交给Northern Nevada Harm Reduction Alliance (NNVHRA)。HOPES继续在其第五街地点提供锐器处理、快速HIV/丙肝检测和当日性病检测。NNVHRA每周六下午3-4点在HOPES停车场分发用品，每周二下午5-6点在Family Soup/Believe Plaza分发。

vi.description: Chuong trinh giam hai truoc day do Northern Nevada HOPES dieu hanh, voi cac dich vu trao doi kim tiem va tiep can duong pho hien da duoc chuyen cho Northern Nevada Harm Reduction Alliance (NNVHRA). HOPES tiep tuc cung cap xu ly vat sac nhon tai dia diem 5th Street, xet nghiem nhanh HIV/Hep C va xet nghiem STI trong ngay. NNVHRA phan phoi vat tu tai bai dau xe HOPES thu Bay 3-4pm va tai Family Soup/Believe Plaza thu Ba 5-6pm.

organizations.name: Washoe County Community Health Services
organizations.description: Public health division of Northern Nevada Public Health (formerly Washoe County Health District) providing immunizations, tuberculosis testing, STI/sexual health testing and treatment, family planning, and WIC nutrition services at the Building B campus on East 9th Street. Sliding fee scale available; serves all Washoe County residents regardless of insurance status.

contacts.value: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Wed 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM

Escala de tarifas deslizante disponible; atiende a todos los residentes del condado de Washoe independientemente del estado de seguro.

tl.description: Public health division ng Northern Nevada Public Health (dating Washoe County Health District) na nagbibigay ng immunizations, tuberculosis testing, STI/sexual health testing at treatment, family planning, at WIC nutrition services sa Building B campus sa East 9th Street. Sliding fee scale available; nagsisilbi sa lahat ng residente ng Washoe County anuman ang insurance status.
tl.eligibility: Lahat ay welcome, bayad batay sa kakayahan

zh.eligibility: 欢迎所有人，按比例收费

vi.description: Bo phan y te cong cong cua Northern Nevada Public Health (truoc day la Khu Y te Quan Washoe) cung cap tiem chung, xet nghiem lao, xet nghiem va dieu tri STI/suc khoe tinh duc, ke hoach hoa gia dinh va dich vu dinh duong WIC tai khuon vien Toa nha B tren duong East 9th Street. Thang phi truot co san; phuc vu tat ca cu dan quan Washoe bat ke tinh trang bao hiem.
vi.eligibility: Chào đón tất cả, phí theo thang trượt

organizations.name: Reno-Sparks Tribal Health Center
organizations.description: Tribally-owned and operated 65,000-square-foot health clinic administered by the Reno-Sparks Indian Colony under a Title V Self-Governance Compact with the Indian Health Service (IHS). Provides comprehensive healthcare including adult medicine, pediatrics, dental care, mental health, pharmacy, podiatry, ophthalmology, physical therapy, women's health, diabetes treatment, substance abuse counseling, and acupuncture for eligible American Indians and Alaska Natives.

contacts.value: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Wed 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM only

es.description: Clinica de salud de 65,000 pies cuadrados de propiedad tribal y operada por la Colonia India Reno-Sparks bajo un Compacto de Autogobernanza Titulo V con el Servicio de Salud Indio (IHS). Proporciona atencion medica integral que incluye medicina para adultos, pediatria, atencion dental, salud mental, farmacia, podologia, oftalmologia, fisioterapia, salud de la mujer, tratamiento de diabetes, consejeria de abuso de sustancias y acupuntura para indios americanos y nativos de Alaska elegibles.
es.eligibility: Miembros de la comunidad nativa americana

tl.description: Tribally-owned at operated na 65,000-square-foot health clinic na pinapatakbo ng Reno-Sparks Indian Colony sa ilalim ng Title V Self-Governance Compact sa Indian Health Service (IHS). Nagbibigay ng komprehensibong healthcare kasama ang adult medicine, pediatrics, dental care, mental health, pharmacy, podiatry, ophthalmology, physical therapy, women's health, diabetes treatment, substance abuse counseling, at acupuncture para sa eligible American Indians at Alaska Natives.
tl.eligibility: Mga miyembro ng Native American community

zh.description: 由里诺-斯帕克斯印第安殖民地在印度卫生局（IHS）Title V自治契约下管理运营的部落所有65,000平方英尺健康诊所。为合格的美洲印第安人和阿拉斯加原住民提供全面医疗服务，包括成人医学、儿科、牙科、心理健康、药房、足病学、眼科、物理治疗、女性健康、糖尿病治疗、药物滥用咨询和针灸。

vi.description: Phong kham suc khoe 65.000 feet vuong do bo lac so huu va dieu hanh boi Khu Dan cu Da do Reno-Sparks theo Hop dong Tu quan Title V voi Co quan Y te Da do (IHS). Cung cap cham soc suc khoe toan dien bao gom y khoa nguoi lon, nhi khoa, nha khoa, suc khoe tam than, duoc pham, benh chan, nhan khoa, vat ly tri lieu, suc khoe phu nu, dieu tri tieu duong, tu van lam dung chat va cham cuu cho nguoi My ban dia va nguoi ban dia Alaska du dieu kien.
vi.eligibility: Thành viên cộng đồng người Mỹ bản địa

organizations.name: Nevada Urban Indians
organizations.description: Nonprofit healthcare and social services agency established in 1975, serving urban American Indians, Alaska Natives, and other underserved community members in northern Nevada. Provides primary medical care, behavioral health services, health screenings, immunizations, diabetes support, victim services for crime survivors, and transportation assistance. Open to all populations regardless of insurance status, with discounted rates based on income.
organizations.eligibility: Native American individuals and families (all populations welcome)

es.description: Agencia sin fines de lucro de servicios sociales y atencion medica establecida en 1975, que sirve a indios americanos urbanos, nativos de Alaska y otros miembros desatendidos de la comunidad en el norte de Nevada. Proporciona atencion medica primaria, servicios de salud mental, examenes de salud, vacunaciones, apoyo para diabetes, servicios a victimas de crimenes y asistencia de transporte. Abierto a todas las poblaciones independientemente del estado de seguro, con tarifas descontadas basadas en ingresos.
es.eligibility: Personas y familias nativas americanas (todas las poblaciones bienvenidas)

tl.description: Nonprofit healthcare at social services agency na itinatag noong 1975, nagsisilbi sa mga urban American Indians, Alaska Natives, at iba pang underserved na miyembro ng komunidad sa northern Nevada. Nagbibigay ng primary medical care, behavioral health services, health screenings, immunizations, diabetes support, victim services para sa crime survivors, at tulong sa transportasyon. Bukas sa lahat ng populasyon anuman ang insurance status, na may discounted rates batay sa kita.
tl.eligibility: Mga Native American na indibidwal at pamilya (lahat ng populasyon welcome)

zh.description: 成立于1975年的非营利医疗保健和社会服务机构，服务北内华达州的城市美洲印第安人、阿拉斯加原住民和其他得不到充分服务的社区成员。提供初级医疗、行为健康服务、健康筛查、免疫接种、糖尿病支持、犯罪受害者服务和交通援助。对所有人群开放，不论保险状况，根据收入提供折扣费率。
zh.eligibility: 美洲原住民个人和家庭（欢迎所有人群）

vi.description: Co quan cham soc suc khoe va dich vu xa hoi phi loi nhuan thanh lap nam 1975, phuc vu nguoi My ban dia thanh thi, nguoi ban dia Alaska va cac thanh vien cong dong thieu phuc vu khac o bac Nevada. Cung cap cham soc y te ban dau, dich vu suc khoe hanh vi, kham suc khoe, tiem chung, ho tro tieu duong, dich vu nan nhan toi pham va ho tro van chuyen. Mo cho tat ca moi nguoi bat ke tinh trang bao hiem, voi muc phi giam theo thu nhap.
vi.eligibility: Cá nhân và gia đình người Mỹ bản địa (chào đón tất cả)

organizations.name: VA Homeless Veteran Care
organizations.description: VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System's Healthcare for Homeless Veterans (HCHV) program, providing free health care, housing assistance, case management, job training, life skills development, and mental health treatment for veterans who are homeless or at risk of homelessness. Walk-in assistance available Wednesdays at the main VA campus (Room G5545, 5th floor).

contacts.label: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans (24/7)

contacts.value: Walk-in: Wednesdays 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM at 975 Kirman Ave

es.description: Programa de Atencion Medica para Veteranos sin Hogar (HCHV) del Sistema de Atencion Medica VA Sierra Nevada, que proporciona atencion medica gratuita, asistencia de vivienda, manejo de casos, capacitacion laboral, desarrollo de habilidades para la vida y tratamiento de salud mental para veteranos que estan sin hogar o en riesgo de quedarse sin hogar. Asistencia sin cita disponible los miercoles en el campus principal del VA (Sala G5545, 5to piso).

tl.description: Healthcare for Homeless Veterans (HCHV) program ng VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System, na nagbibigay ng libreng health care, housing assistance, case management, job training, life skills development, at mental health treatment para sa mga beteranong homeless o nanganganib na maging homeless. Walk-in assistance available tuwing Miyerkules sa pangunahing VA campus (Room G5545, 5th floor).

zh.description: VA Sierra Nevada医疗系统的无家可归退伍军人医疗保健（HCHV）项目，为无家可归或面临无家可归风险的退伍军人提供免费医疗、住房援助、个案管理、职业培训、生活技能发展和心理健康治疗。每周三在VA主校区（G5545室，5楼）提供免预约援助。

vi.description: Chuong trinh Cham soc Suc khoe cho Cuu Chien binh Vo gia cu (HCHV) cua He thong Y te VA Sierra Nevada, cung cap cham soc suc khoe mien phi, ho tro nha o, quan ly truong hop, dao tao viec lam, phat trien ky nang song va dieu tri suc khoe tam than cho cuu chien binh vo gia cu hoac co nguy co vo gia cu. Ho tro khong can hen vao thu Tu tai khuon vien VA chinh (Phong G5545, tang 5).
vi.eligibility: Cựu chiến binh

organizations.name: WellCare Health Services
organizations.description: Comprehensive behavioral health services operated by WC Health (formerly WellCare Foundation). Programs include the Community Triage Center (CTC) providing crisis stabilization and medical detox, the Psychiatric Urgent Facility (PUF House) for psychiatric assessment and outpatient linkage, and outpatient treatment. Walk-ins accepted, hospital discharges, and community referrals welcome.

es.description: Servicios integrales de salud conductual operados por WC Health (anteriormente WellCare Foundation). Incluye el Centro de Triaje Comunitario (CTC) con estabilización de crisis y desintoxicación médica, la Instalación Psiquiátrica Urgente (PUF House) para evaluación psiquiátrica, y tratamiento ambulatorio. Se aceptan visitas sin cita previa.

tl.description: Komprehensibong behavioral health services na pinapatakbo ng WC Health (dating WellCare Foundation). Kasama ang Community Triage Center (CTC) para sa crisis stabilization at medical detox, Psychiatric Urgent Facility (PUF House) para sa psychiatric assessment, at outpatient treatment. Walk-ins welcome.

zh.description: WC Health（前WellCare Foundation）运营的综合行为健康服务。包括社区分流中心（CTC）提供危机稳定和医疗戒毒、精神科紧急设施（PUF House）提供精神评估，以及门诊治疗。接受无预约来访。

vi.description: Dịch vụ sức khỏe hành vi toàn diện do WC Health (trước đây là WellCare Foundation) vận hành. Bao gồm Trung tâm Phân loại Cộng đồng (CTC) với ổn định khủng hoảng và cai nghiện y tế, Cơ sở Tâm thần Khẩn cấp (PUF House) để đánh giá tâm thần, và điều trị ngoại trú. Chấp nhận đến không hẹn trước.

organizations.name: Silver Summit Behavioral Health
organizations.description: Behavioral health provider for SilverSummit Medicaid members. Provides access to mental health counseling, substance use treatment, and psychiatric services through an in-network provider directory. Members can search for local providers by specialty. SilverSummit is a Centene Corporation Medicaid managed care plan.

es.description: Proveedor de salud conductual para miembros de Medicaid de SilverSummit. Acceso a consejería de salud mental, tratamiento de uso de sustancias y servicios psiquiátricos a través de un directorio de proveedores en red. Plan de Medicaid de Centene Corporation.

tl.description: Behavioral health provider para sa SilverSummit Medicaid members. Access sa mental health counseling, substance use treatment, at psychiatric services sa pamamagitan ng in-network provider directory. Centene Corporation Medicaid managed care plan.

zh.description: 面向SilverSummit Medicaid会员的行为健康服务提供者。通过网内提供者目录获取心理健康咨询、物质使用治疗和精神科服务。Centene Corporation管理式护理计划。

vi.description: Nhà cung cấp sức khỏe hành vi cho thành viên SilverSummit Medicaid. Truy cập tư vấn sức khỏe tâm thần, điều trị sử dụng chất và dịch vụ tâm thần thông qua danh bạ nhà cung cấp trong mạng lưới. Kế hoạch Medicaid của Centene Corporation.
vi.eligibility: Thành viên SilverSummit Medicaid

organizations.name: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield Medicaid
organizations.description: Nevada Medicaid managed care plan operated by Anthem, serving Nevada families since 2009. Provides comprehensive medical, dental, vision, behavioral health, and pharmacy coverage at no cost to members with no copays. Includes 24/7 NurseLine for medical advice in 170+ languages and free LiveHealth Online video visits.

es.description: Plan de atencion medica administrada de Medicaid de Nevada operado por Anthem, sirviendo a familias de Nevada desde 2009. Proporciona cobertura medica, dental, de vision, salud mental y farmacia integral sin costo para los miembros y sin copagos. Incluye linea de enfermeria 24/7 para consejos medicos en mas de 170 idiomas y visitas de video LiveHealth Online gratuitas.

tl.description: Nevada Medicaid managed care plan na pinapatakbo ng Anthem, nagsisilbi sa mga pamilya sa Nevada mula 2009. Nagbibigay ng komprehensibong medikal, dental, vision, behavioral health, at pharmacy coverage nang walang bayad sa mga miyembro at walang copays. Kasama ang 24/7 NurseLine para sa medikal na payo sa 170+ na wika at libreng LiveHealth Online video visits.

zh.description: 由Anthem运营的内华达州Medicaid管理式医疗计划，自2009年以来服务内华达州家庭。为会员免费提供全面的医疗、牙科、视力、行为健康和药房保障，无需共付。包括24/7护士热线（提供170多种语言的医疗建议）和免费LiveHealth Online视频就诊。

vi.description: Ke hoach Medicaid quan ly boi Anthem, phuc vu cac gia dinh Nevada tu nam 2009. Cung cap bao hiem y te, nha khoa, thi luc, suc khoe hanh vi va duoc pham toan dien mien phi cho thanh vien khong co dong thanh toan. Bao gom duong day y ta 24/7 tu van y te bang hon 170 ngon ngu va kham video LiveHealth Online mien phi.
vi.eligibility: Đủ điều kiện Nevada Medicaid

organizations.name: CareSource Nevada Medicaid
organizations.description: Nevada's only nonprofit Medicaid managed care plan, offering comprehensive health benefits including medical, behavioral health, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage with no copays. Members receive a large provider network, reward programs, and free rides to healthcare appointments and pharmacies.

es.description: El unico plan de atencion medica administrada de Medicaid sin fines de lucro de Nevada, que ofrece beneficios de salud integrales que incluyen cobertura medica, de salud mental, farmacia, dental y de vision sin copagos. Los miembros reciben una amplia red de proveedores, programas de recompensas y viajes gratuitos a citas medicas y farmacias.

tl.description: Ang tanging nonprofit na Medicaid managed care plan ng Nevada, na nag-aalok ng komprehensibong benepisyo sa kalusugan kasama ang medikal, behavioral health, pharmacy, dental, at vision coverage nang walang copays. Ang mga miyembro ay tumatanggap ng malaking provider network, reward programs, at libreng sakay papunta sa mga appointment at botika.

zh.description: 内华达州唯一的非营利Medicaid管理式医疗计划，提供全面的健康福利，包括医疗、行为健康、药房、牙科和视力保障，无需共付。会员可享受大型医疗网络、奖励计划和免费前往医疗预约和药房的交通服务。

vi.description: Ke hoach Medicaid phi loi nhuan duy nhat cua Nevada, cung cap cac quyen loi suc khoe toan dien bao gom y te, suc khoe hanh vi, duoc pham, nha khoa va thi luc khong co dong thanh toan. Thanh vien duoc huong mang luoi nha cung cap lon, chuong trinh thuong va di chuyen mien phi den cac cuoc hen va nha thuoc.
vi.eligibility: Đủ điều kiện Nevada Medicaid

organizations.name: Molina Healthcare Nevada
organizations.description: Nevada Medicaid and Nevada Check Up managed care plan providing comprehensive health coverage in Clark and Washoe counties. Benefits include medical, behavioral health, pharmacy, dental (through Liberty Dental Plan), vision (through VSP), and non-emergency medical transportation (through MTM). Member services available in multiple languages with interpreter services upon request.

es.description: Plan de atencion medica administrada de Medicaid y Nevada Check Up que proporciona cobertura integral de salud en los condados de Clark y Washoe. Los beneficios incluyen cobertura medica, de salud mental, farmacia, dental (a traves de Liberty Dental Plan), vision (a traves de VSP) y transporte medico no de emergencia (a traves de MTM). Servicios al miembro disponibles en multiples idiomas con servicios de interpretacion por telefono.

tl.description: Medicaid at Nevada Check Up managed care plan na nagbibigay ng komprehensibong health coverage sa Clark at Washoe counties. Kasama sa mga benepisyo ang medikal, behavioral health, pharmacy, dental (sa pamamagitan ng Liberty Dental Plan), vision (sa pamamagitan ng VSP), at non-emergency medical transportation (sa pamamagitan ng MTM). Member services available sa maraming wika na may interpreter services.

zh.description: Medicaid和Nevada Check Up管理式医疗计划，在克拉克县和沃肖县提供全面的健康保障。福利包括医疗、行为健康、药房、牙科（通过Liberty Dental Plan）、视力（通过VSP）和非紧急医疗运输（通过MTM）。会员服务提供多语言支持和口译服务。

vi.description: Ke hoach Medicaid va Nevada Check Up cung cap bao hiem suc khoe toan dien tai cac quan Clark va Washoe. Quyen loi bao gom y te, suc khoe hanh vi, duoc pham, nha khoa (qua Liberty Dental Plan), thi luc (qua VSP) va van chuyen y te khong khan cap (qua MTM). Dich vu thanh vien co san bang nhieu ngon ngu voi dich vu thong dich.
vi.eligibility: Đủ điều kiện Nevada Medicaid

organizations.name: SilverSummit Healthplan
organizations.description: Nevada Medicaid managed care plan operated by Centene Corporation, providing comprehensive health coverage including medical, behavioral health, pharmacy, vision, dental, and transportation benefits. Member services are available 24/7 with multilingual support and free interpreter services. Has a local Washoe County office at the Mill Street Care Center for in-person assistance.

contacts.label: Washoe County local office (Mill Street Care Center)

es.description: Plan de atencion medica administrada de Medicaid de Nevada operado por Centene Corporation, que proporciona cobertura integral de salud que incluye beneficios medicos, de salud mental, farmacia, vision, dental y transporte. Servicios al miembro disponibles 24/7 con soporte multilingue y servicios de interpretacion gratuitos. Tiene una oficina local del condado de Washoe en el Mill Street Care Center para asistencia en persona.

tl.description: Nevada Medicaid managed care plan na pinapatakbo ng Centene Corporation, na nagbibigay ng komprehensibong health coverage kasama ang medikal, behavioral health, pharmacy, vision, dental, at transportation benefits. Member services available 24/7 na may multilingual support at libreng interpreter services. May lokal na Washoe County office sa Mill Street Care Center para sa personal na tulong.

zh.description: 由Centene Corporation运营的内华达州Medicaid管理式医疗计划，提供全面的健康保障，包括医疗、行为健康、药房、视力、牙科和交通福利。会员服务24/7全天候提供，支持多语言和免费口译服务。在Mill Street Care Center设有当地沃肖县办公室提供当面援助。

vi.description: Ke hoach Medicaid quan ly boi Centene Corporation, cung cap bao hiem suc khoe toan dien bao gom y te, suc khoe hanh vi, duoc pham, thi luc, nha khoa va quyen loi van chuyen. Dich vu thanh vien 24/7 voi ho tro da ngon ngu va dich vu phien dich mien phi. Co van phong dia phuong tai quan Washoe o Mill Street Care Center de ho tro truc tiep.
vi.eligibility: Đủ điều kiện Nevada Medicaid

organizations.name: DSS Reno (Division of Social Services)
organizations.description: Main Reno district office of the Nevada Division of Social Services (renamed from DWSS in July 2025). Provides in-person assistance for SNAP (food assistance), TANF (cash assistance), Medicaid, Nevada Check Up, Energy Assistance Program, Water/Sewer Assistance, and Child Care Assistance. Applications can also be submitted online through Access Nevada (accessnevada.nv.gov).

es.description: Oficina distrital principal de Reno de la Division de Servicios Sociales de Nevada (renombrada de DWSS en julio de 2025). Proporciona asistencia en persona para SNAP (asistencia alimentaria), TANF (asistencia en efectivo), Medicaid, Nevada Check Up, Programa de Asistencia Energetica, Asistencia de Agua/Alcantarillado y Asistencia de Cuidado Infantil. Las solicitudes tambien se pueden enviar en linea a traves de Access Nevada (accessnevada.nv.gov).

tl.description: Pangunahing opisina ng Reno ng Nevada Division of Social Services (pinalitan ang pangalan mula DWSS noong Hulyo 2025). Nagbibigay ng personal na tulong para sa SNAP (tulong sa pagkain), TANF (tulong sa pera), Medicaid, Nevada Check Up, Energy Assistance Program, Water/Sewer Assistance, at Child Care Assistance. Maaari ring isumite ang mga aplikasyon online sa pamamagitan ng Access Nevada (accessnevada.nv.gov).

zh.description: 内华达州社会服务部（2025年7月从DWSS更名）里诺主要地区办公室。提供SNAP（食品援助）、TANF（现金援助）、Medicaid、Nevada Check Up、能源援助计划、水/下水道援助和儿童保育援助的当面服务。也可通过Access Nevada (accessnevada.nv.gov)在线提交申请。

vi.description: Van phong chinh tai Reno cua Bo Dich vu Xa hoi Nevada (doi ten tu DWSS vao thang 7 nam 2025). Cung cap ho tro truc tiep cho SNAP (ho tro thuc pham), TANF (ho tro tien mat), Medicaid, Nevada Check Up, Chuong trinh Ho tro Nang luong, Ho tro Nuoc/Cong va Ho tro Giu tre. Don cung co the nop truc tuyen qua Access Nevada (accessnevada.nv.gov).

organizations.name: DSS Sparks (Division of Social Services)
organizations.description: Sparks district office of the Nevada Division of Social Services (renamed from DWSS in July 2025). Provides in-person assistance for SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, Nevada Check Up, Energy Assistance, and Child Care Assistance. A second Sparks location at 921 12th Street handles appointments only. Applications can also be submitted online at accessnevada.nv.gov.

es.description: Oficina distrital de Sparks de la Division de Servicios Sociales de Nevada (renombrada de DWSS en julio de 2025). Proporciona asistencia en persona para SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, Nevada Check Up, Asistencia Energetica y Asistencia de Cuidado Infantil. Una segunda ubicacion en Sparks en 921 12th Street atiende solo con cita. Las solicitudes tambien se pueden enviar en linea en accessnevada.nv.gov.

tl.description: Opisina ng Sparks ng Nevada Division of Social Services (pinalitan ang pangalan mula DWSS noong Hulyo 2025). Nagbibigay ng personal na tulong para sa SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, Nevada Check Up, Energy Assistance, at Child Care Assistance. Ang pangalawang lokasyon sa Sparks sa 921 12th Street ay tumatanggap lamang ng may appointment. Maaari ring isumite ang mga aplikasyon online sa accessnevada.nv.gov.

zh.description: 内华达州社会服务部（2025年7月从DWSS更名）斯帕克斯地区办公室。提供SNAP、TANF、Medicaid、Nevada Check Up、能源援助和儿童保育援助的当面服务。斯帕克斯第二个地点位于921 12th Street，仅接受预约。也可在accessnevada.nv.gov在线提交申请。

vi.description: Van phong Sparks cua Bo Dich vu Xa hoi Nevada (doi ten tu DWSS vao thang 7 nam 2025). Cung cap ho tro truc tiep cho SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, Nevada Check Up, Ho tro Nang luong va Ho tro Giu tre. Dia diem Sparks thu hai tai 921 12th Street chi nhan hen. Don cung co the nop truc tuyen tai accessnevada.nv.gov.

organizations.name: Nevada DMV - ID Services
